A '''Warden Heart''' is a {{Legendary}} item obtained very rarely from the {{SlayerTier|V}} {{MobSprite|Atoned Horror}}. It can be used to craft the {{Item|Warden Helmet}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob Drops ===
A '''Warden Heart''' is an {{O|r i|no=y}} drop. It has a {{Green|0.0137%}} ({{Green|1}}/{{Yellow|7263.5}}) chance to drop from a {{SlayerTier|V}} {{MobSprite|Atoned Horror}}. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Zombie Slayer 7}}.

=== Raffle of the Century ===
'''Warden Heart''' can also be obtained as a {{Gold|'''MEDIUM'''}} reward from [[Raffle of the Century]].

* The '''Warden Heart''' was the first item in the game with an {{O|r i}} drop chance.
